Dental care in Auckland

Auckland is served by 489 dental practices listed on Dental Compare, spread across 112 suburbs including Remuera, Takapuna, Auckland CBD, Henderson. Whether you need a routine checkup, an emergency appointment or cosmetic work, you can compare prices, patient ratings and services side by side before you book, with no phoning around required.

Dentist prices in Auckland

Prices vary between practices in Auckland. Compare published checkup and hygienist fees for individual clinics in the listings above. A hygienist visit is a professional clean, and many practices bundle it with a routine checkup.

Dentists across Auckland

Practices are listed in Remuera, Takapuna, Auckland CBD, Henderson, Albany, Pukekohe, Newmarket, Mount Roskill, Papakura, Papatoetoe. Use the Suburb/Town filter above to narrow results to your area, or search by clinic name.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a dental checkup cost in Auckland?

Checkup prices in Auckland vary by practice. Compare published checkup fees for individual clinics in the listings above, and ask what's included (some bundle X-rays or a clean) when you book.

Is there free or low-cost dental care in Auckland?

Dental care is free for children and teenagers up to their 18th birthday through the Community Dental Service and school dental clinics. Adults on a low income may qualify for a Work and Income (WINZ) dental grant of up to $1,000 a year for emergency treatment, and ACC covers dental treatment needed because of an accident or injury. Some practices also offer reduced fees for Community Services Card holders.

Are there emergency dentists in Auckland?

Yes. A number of Auckland practices offer same-day emergency appointments for issues like severe toothache, broken or knocked-out teeth and dental trauma. Use the Emergency service filter above to see clinics that provide urgent care, and call ahead to confirm availability.

Do Auckland dentists offer payment plans?

Many do. Practices across Auckland accept options such as Q Card, Afterpay, Zip and Gem Visa, and some offer interest-free plans for larger treatments like implants or orthodontics. Accepted payment options are listed on each clinic's profile.

How much is a hygienist visit in Auckland?

A hygienist visit is a professional clean. Prices in Auckland vary by practice and appointment length. Compare hygienist fees for individual clinics using the Max Hygienist Price filter above.

How do I choose the right dentist in Auckland?

Compare practices on what matters to you: patient ratings and review counts, published prices, location and the specific services you need (such as orthodontics, implants or teen dental). Dental Compare lets you filter by all of these and view up to four clinics side by side before you book.
